summary_markdown:
The team discussed the deployment of a new version, which included removing `company/assets` and `inventory` from non-admin menus. A major topic was migrating data storage from ClickHouse (CH) to S3 using TTL (Time To Live). This migration aims to improve performance and reduce reliance on CH for older raw data.

Regarding the migration:
*   The current process of running a nightly script comparing S3 data is noted, but it may be replaced by the new system.
*   A plan was discussed to upgrade the production version to support direct S3 transfer from CH. This upgrade will involve optimizing read performance for S3 and utilizing multi-threaded/parallel reading capabilities.
*   Concerns were raised about how client requests (e.g., `SELECT * FROM raw_device_seen_2 ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 500`) would interact with the new S3 storage layer, ensuring that reads are handled efficiently and not exposed directly to slow data sources.
decisions: The development team will proceed with upgrading the production environment to facilitate direct TTL-based transfer of raw data from ClickHouse to S3.
action_items: Implement a mechanism to ensure that client reads are routed efficiently when using the new S3 storage layer, avoiding slow queries against raw historical data.
